Returns region-level entries in MOFA's Japanese text with English level labels, levels present, a derived max level (not a country-wide level), infectiou

tools.name: mofa_level_changes
tools.description: Which countries had their Japan MOFA danger or infectious disease danger levels (or region texts) change since a given time? From this service's own observation record: old and new levels, MOFA info ids and issue dates, when we observed the change and when we last saw the old state, plus polling gap

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Re-fetch the stored result of a settled paid call by its receipt_id, for when the response was lost after payment. Free. Unknown or unsettled receipt ids return RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND. Results are kept for 90 days after settlement.
